statement: This sketch creates a dynamic field of compass-like pointers that respond to user interaction. Each needle is individually controlled, rotating smoothly to point toward the cursor when it moves across the canvas. When the cursor leaves the area, the needles gradually lose their targeted focus and begin to drift naturally, eventually settling into a shared direction that simulates returning to true north. The visualization uses a subtle trail effect and color variation to enhance the sense of motion and cohesion, creating an immersive experience where the entire field reacts as a unified system while maintaining individual pointer characteristics.
